withdrawFirstBody: You still have {{balance}} in your account. Withdraw it first, or delete your account anyway and forfeit it.
warningBalanceNote: Your remaining {{balance}} will be sent to your bank.
warningForfeitNote: Your remaining {{balance}} will be forfeited. You won't be able to get it back.
warningPoint1: Your account and profile are permanently deleted.
warningPoint2: Your Instagram is disconnected and its data removed.
warningPoint3: Any shares awaiting payment are cancelled.
verifyBody: Enter the code we sent to {{email}}.
deletedBody: Your account has been deleted. We're sorry to see you go.
deletedWithBalanceBody: Your account has been deleted and your balance is on its way to your bank.
fundsLockedBody: You have a withdrawal in progress. Please wait for it to finish, then try again.
sweepInFlightBody: We're sending your balance to your bank. Try again in a moment.
mustWithdrawBody: You have money in your account, so it can't be deleted yet. Cash out your balance, then try again.
codeExpiredBody: This code is no longer valid. Tap Resend code to get a new one.
deleteFailedBody: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
